answer: Score co-sealing correlation. Each epoch, compare every pair of graders who shared a jury: if two identities agree on more than 95% of 20+ shared rows, flag the pair, pull both from seats for 8 epochs and send their co-sealed rows to 4 fresh random graders. Honest graders behave like shale, layered and formed separately; a sybil farm is quartz, one crystal grown from one script, and its votes line up too cleanly. Honest agents crack this like a walnut by voting their own reading, while a 50-identity farm must fake 50 independent histories.
